info.title: LP Ranger API
info.description: REST API for the LP Ranger auto-rebalancing concentrated liquidity manager. Manages V3 NFT positions on 9mm Pro (PulseChain).

tags.name: UI
tags.description: Static JSON the dashboard fetches at init: shipped defaults, provider metadata, and display labels.

tags.name: API Keys
tags.description: Encrypted third-party credentials (Moralis). Keys are AES-256-GCM encrypted at rest and never returned by any endpoint.

tags.name: Telegram
tags.description: Telegram bot credentials and per-event notification toggles. Credentials are stored encrypted and only their presence is reported back.

tags.name: Price Lookups
tags.description: Idle-driven pause for quota-limited USD price endpoints.

get.description: Returns 200 OK with server port and timestamp. Used by load balancers and process managers.
Returns global server state and per-position bot state. Polled every 3 seconds by the dashboard.

rpcUrl.description: The endpoint currently in use — the live primary, which changes the moment an operator adds or promotes one. Not the value resolved at startup.

positions.description: Per-position state keyed by composite key (blockchain-wallet-contract-tokenId)

post.description: Update global or per-position config. Position-specific keys require a positionKey (composite key validated by parseCompositeKey).

positionKey.description: Composite key (blockchain-wallet-contract-tokenId). Required for position-specific keys.

impermanentLossGuardPct.description: Impermanent Loss Guard, percent. Per position. Bounds come from impermanentLossGuardPctMin/Max in bot-config-defaults.json.

checkIntervalSec.description: On-chain poll frequency, seconds. Per position. A value outside the range is refused with 400 and nothing is saved; bounds come from src/timer-bounds.js, which every road into this setting shares.

rangeOverrideEnabled.description: Bot Settings > Range "No Override" toggle. false = re-use the position's existing on-chain range on the next rebalance and ignore the three Range settings below.

rebalanceRangeWidthPct.description: Price Range Extension: half-width of the new range as a percent of the current price. Ignored while rangeOverrideEnabled is false.

fullRangeRebalanceEnabled.description: Mint the next rebalance across the full tick range. Ignored while rangeOverrideEnabled is false.

offsetToken0Pct.description: Position offset bias toward token0; 50 is balanced.

slippagePctToken0.description: Per-token slippage tolerance for token0 swaps. Overrides slippagePct for that leg.

slippagePctToken1.description: Per-token slippage tolerance for token1 swaps.

totalLifetimeDepositUsd.description: User-entered lifetime deposit, USD. Basis for Lifetime Net P&L.

depositUsedFallback.description: True when the lifetime deposit is bot-detected rather than user-entered.

lifetimeStartDateOverrideUtc.description: ISO-8601 UTC date. Overrides the detected start of the lifetime window.

decimalsOverride0.description: Manual decimals for token0, when on-chain detection fails.

decimalsOverrideForce0.description: Apply decimalsOverride0 even when on-chain detection succeeded.

decimalsOverrideForce1.description: Apply decimalsOverride1 even when on-chain detection succeeded.

compoundedAmount0.description: Lifetime token0 swept back into liquidity, in coins. Priced at the current price wherever it is displayed — never stored as a dollar total.

compoundedAmount1.description: Lifetime token1 swept back into liquidity, in coins.

lastCompoundAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent compound.

compoundHistory.description: One entry per compound, historical scans included.

nftGasWeiByTokenId.description: Gas spent per NFT in the rebalance chain, keyed by tokenId. Values are wei as decimal strings.

nftCompoundedAmountsByTokenId.description: Compounded coins per NFT in the rebalance chain, keyed by tokenId.

hodlBaseline.description: Deposited amounts and mint-time prices for the held NFT. Basis for IL/G and for the Impermanent Loss Guard.

entryValue.description: USD value of the NFT at its own mint.

price0.description: USD price of token0 at mint.

price1.description: USD price of token1 at mint.

residuals.description: Per-pool wallet residuals, keyed by pool address. Raw token units as decimal strings.

rpcUrls.description: GLOBAL. JSON-RPC endpoints added by the operator, most recently added first. The first entry is the primary; the endpoints shipped in chains.json stay behind them as failover. Applied immediately, without a restart.

approvalMultiple.description: GLOBAL. ERC-20 approval multiplier for swap allowances.

gasFeePct.description: GLOBAL. Gas-cost ceiling as a percent of position value. Bounds: gasFeePctMin/Max in bot-config-defaults.json.

priceCacheTtlMs.description: GLOBAL. In-memory token-price cache TTL, ms.

dustUnitPriceCacheMultiplier.description: GLOBAL. Dust-unit-price TTL as a multiple of priceCacheTtlMs.

moveCacheTtlMs.description: GLOBAL. Cache TTL for the fresh-price window around a rebalance or compound.

pricePauseExceptionPollWindowMultiple.description: GLOBAL. Poll cycles between the balanced-band notifier fresh-price probes.

moralisEnabled.description: GLOBAL. Whether the stored Moralis API key is used for price lookups. Independent of whether a key exists: false stops the calls without discarding the key. Default true.

400.description: Missing or invalid positionKey for position-specific keys, or a dashboard-settable value outside its range. The two are told apart by the response's invalidValueForKey field, which names the setting whose value was refused and is absent on a malformed request. Values are refused, never corrected, and nothing in the request is applied. Ranges are declared in src/config-bounds.js; null clears a setting rather than being checked.

get.description: Returns whether a wallet is loaded, its address, and lock state.

post.description: Decrypt the wallet file with the provided password.
Import a wallet via seed phrase or private key. Encrypts and persists to app-config/user-configurable/wallet.json.

delete.description: Delete the encrypted wallet file from disk.

post.description: Decrypt and return the plaintext private key. Requires password.
Enumerate up to 300 NFT and ERC-20 LP positions for the loaded wallet. Results are cached.
Re-read on-chain liquidity for previously scanned positions.

get.description: Returns all positions currently managed by the bot with their status.

post.description: Start a bot loop for the specified NFT position. Requires a loaded wallet with a private key.

400.description: Missing tokenId or no private key

409.description: Another position already manages this pool. LP Ranger manages one position per liquidity pool so that profit and loss stays attributable to it. The body names the position holding the pool.

conflictTokenId.description: NFT id of the running position holding the pool.

delete.description: Stop the bot loop for a position. Sets status to 'stopped' but keeps config data.

post.description: Fast fetch of pool state, token prices, value, composition, and current P&L for an unmanaged position.

200.description: Position details with pool state, value, and P&L

post.description: Slow fetch: event scan + epoch reconstruction for historical P&L data. May take several minutes on first call (cold cache).

200.description: Lifetime P&L with daily breakdown, gas costs, and rebalance events

get.description: Fetch historical P&L data for a closed (drained) NFT position.

200.description: Historical P&L for the closed position

post.description: Trigger a manual rebalance for a managed position. Range width comes from the position's saved rebalanceRangeWidthPct config (Bot Settings > Range); no width is accepted on this endpoint.
Collect unclaimed fees and reinvest as liquidity on the same NFT position.
Stop all managed positions and shut down the server.

get.description: Returns the contents of app-config/app-defaults-for-user-configurable/ui-defaults.json (e.g. soundsEnabled). Used by the dashboard at init for fresh-profile defaults.

Returns the contents of app-config/app-defaults-for-user-configurable/lp-providers.json — LP-provider metadata keyed by <poolFactoryAddress>_<positionManagerAddress> in EIP-55 checksum casing. Each entry is an object { displayName: string, supportedBlockchainsByLpRangerAndLpProvider: string[] } where supportedBlockchainsByLpRangerAndLpProvider is a list of canonical chain IDs (KEYs of chains.json, e.g. "pulsechain") that we've verified for that deployment.

Returns the contents of app-config/app-defaults-for-user-configurable/bot-config-defaults.json — single source of truth for default values of every Bot Settings input plus server-internal nested groups (lowGasThresholds, residualCleanup). Per-user overrides live in app-config/user-configurable/bot-config.json.

Serves app-config/app-defaults-for-user-configurable/setting-labels.json. The dashboard uses it to render Activity Log "Setting Saved" entries as a label plus unit instead of a raw key. Always 200 — a missing or malformed file yields an empty map and the client falls back to the raw key.

200.description: Label map keyed by config key.

get.description: Serves the tracked chart-provider list the Pool Details dialog links out to. Always 200; an unreadable file yields an empty list and the dialog renders no links rather than blocking.

Serves the active chain's RPC endpoints, most-preferred first, so the dashboard's Network section is built from configuration rather than hardcoded in markup. The list is the same one failover walks, so it cannot advertise an endpoint the bot would not use. `saved` is reported separately because the Add RPC dialog prepends to the operator's own list only — sending it the composed list would copy the shipped endpoints into saved config, where they would stop tracking chains.json. Always 200; an empty `endpoints` list means none are configured.

200.description: Ordered endpoint list, plus the operator-added subset.

endpoints.description: Every endpoint, in the order failover walks them.

primary.description: True for the endpoint currently in use. Exactly one entry is true, and it is the first.

saved.description: Endpoints the operator added via Add RPC, most recently added first. Excludes the endpoints shipped in chains.json. Empty on a fresh install.

post.description: Encrypts the key to app-config/user-configurable/api-keys.json (AES-256-GCM). A Moralis key is validated with a live ping after saving; the ping result is logged, not returned. Falls back to the wallet session password when password is omitted.

password.description: Wallet password. Optional when the wallet is already unlocked this session.

400.description: service, key, and password are required.

get.description: Reports whether a Moralis key is present and usable. "none" = no key stored; "locked" = stored but the wallet has not been unlocked this session, so it cannot be decrypted; "invalid" = the live ping failed. Always 200, including on ping failure.

Never returns the token or chat ID — only whether each is stored. balancedThresholdPct and balancedCooldownMs surface code-only constants from balanced-notifier.js so the dashboard can render the checkbox label percent and cadence without a second literal.

post.description: Each field is optional and saved independently. botToken and chatId are encrypted at rest and require a password (or an unlocked wallet session); enabledEvents is written to the bot-config global section and needs neither.

password.description: Required only when saving botToken or chatId.

post.description: Sends a message through the configured bot to verify credentials end to end.

Posted by the browser after 15 minutes without input. Price endpoints are quota-limited, so the dashboard stops asking for fresh prices while nobody is watching. A rebalance or compound bypasses the pause for its own duration. Also resets the server-side idle countdown.
Posted on the next throttled activity event after an idle pause.

post.summary: Check whether a drained position can be re-opened
post.description: Reads both token balances from the wallet and compares each against the live dust threshold. Re-opening needs at least one non-dust balance. Returns 503 with a structured code when the wallet balance cannot be read right now, which the dashboard renders as a try-again-later message rather than a failure.

200.description: Decision plus the balances behind it.

400.description: Wallet not loaded, or token0/token1 missing.

post.description: Clears the position's error and pause state and asks its bot loop to run a fresh cycle. Rejected while a rebalance or scan is already in flight. liveKey is the resolved composite key, which may differ from the one sent if a rebalance minted a new tokenId in the meantime.

409.description: An operation is already in progress.

post.summary: Re-value a position at freshly fetched prices
post.description: Asks the position's next lifetime scan to rebuild every stored dollar figure at freshly fetched prices: Fees Compounded, the lifetime deposit, and the HODL baseline's entry value. The token amounts behind them are re-read from the chain but never re-derived from the pool's history, which is what makes this cheaper than a reload. Nothing is deleted: each figure is overwritten once its replacement exists, so a scan that fails leaves the old figure in place. Only a managed position has a running bot loop to pick the re-scan up, so an unmanaged one is rejected with 409 "not-managed" rather than silently doing nothing.

includeDailyPnl.description: Also re-price the Per-Day P&L table — every closed period's gas and both pair-token prices. A closed period keeps its dollar figures but not the token amounts behind them, so this re-reads each NFT's history: minutes on a long rebalance chain. Still skips the five-year pool scan that Reload Current Position performs.

limitToRecentDays.description: Rebuild only the most recent periods of the Per-Day P&L table, leaving older rows with the figures they already hold. A flag, not a day count: the window length is the rescanPricesRecentWindowDays shipped default, so a request cannot ask for a reach the dashboard never offered. Ignored without includeDailyPnl, since nothing else this route re-values is date-scoped. Ignored too when the table is incomplete, because a stored period does not record which NFT it came from, so a partial rebuild cannot tell a gap from an old period.

post.description: Aborts the 5-year event scan for one pool. aborted reports whether a scan was actually running; flagReset reports whether the position's scan-in-progress flag was cleared, which is what re-enables Reload Current Position. positionKey is resolved to the live key first, since the dashboard may hold a key that a parallel rebalance has already migrated.

positionKey.description: Optional. Clears the scan-in-progress flag as well.

walletAddress.description: Optional. Defaults to the loaded wallet.
